verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims automatic syncing across thousands of native integrations, covering card swipe through month-end close. It also documents an Accounting API, automated GL coding by entity, and one-click accruals, so an accounting-sync capability exists in its own docs. The evidence never names a specific ERP, and it never shows that sync runs in real time or in both directions. Missing for 10: named ERP connectors (e.g., NetSuite/QuickBooks), documented real-time sync, documented bidirectional data flow, independent or hands-on corroboration that sync replaces manual journal entries.
